decisions.rationale: The complete technical term directly attests divisive speech. Its English phrase names the action; no speculative PHRA/divisive member is forced.

The complete according-to-intention adverbial construction is rendered purposely. BSAMS supplies thinking/intention and BZHIN DU as/in accordance with; no exact full master entry exists and its proper behavior mined fragment does not attest this meaning. Keep the grammatical construction whole at d3.
The explicit negative MA owns without in the lack-of-mistake condition. It does not also own purposely, despite the misleading mined full MA NOR BAR gloss purposely and without.
NOR directly supports mistake within the negated condition. The adverbial BAR and supplied any remain outside, with no invented identity noun.
The first PHA ROL PO denotes the people being divided, directly supported by others. It is distinct from the later complete agentive PHA ROL POS naming the hearer.
MDZA BA directly attests friends, including a separate uncertain friends? entry retained as counterevidence. The relative who are is supplied grammar around this relational noun.
The complete DBYE BA glossary directly attests split up. Its bound genitive supports the following purpose construction without a separate English word.
Purpose PHYIR supplies the local grammatical meant to. Direct is meant to/for/to candidates and the clause support this, without treating the predicate as an extra source meant verb.

This complete PA CAN form directly attests mentally afflicted, and its qualification modifies explicit SEMS/state. The broader afflicted state of mind candidate does not justify claiming the same state twice.

Explicit SEMS is the mind/state-of-mind noun, locally rendered state after mentally afflicted. This contextual head is supported by the complete mind/state-of-thought material, not a claim of a standalone literal state HGM gloss.

The explicit TSHIG supplies the opening words, whose meaning is later required to be understood. Although full TSHIG DON has meanings of words material, this English realization is discontinuous and the two lexical heads are kept separate.
DON directly attests meaning. It is not transferred to GO BA even though that separate master has a meaning gloss; GO BA is the understanding predicate here.

Keep the complete agentive-inflected phrase with its by the other person counterpart at d3. Do not strip final -s from POS to fabricate a particle; no exact full master entry is claimed, but PHA ROL PO person and the complete case construction support the phrase.
GO BA directly attests understood and is the hearer-comprehension predicate. The final bound apostrophe-O closes the statement; English should be is explanatory/passive support and stays unwrapped.
